content_sections.heading: About ILBS Project Assistant
content_sections.text: The Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences (ILBS) in New Delhi is conducting recruitment for a Project Assistant position under the research project "Hospital Based Cancer Registries in India" (HBCRI). The position is funded by the ICMR-National Institute of NCD Epidemiology (NINE). The appointed candidate will be posted at ILBS, New Delhi, to assist the project team with data extraction, updating, analysis, and related administrative tasks for registered cancer patients.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential eligibility criteria specified by the institute to apply for the Project Assistant position. Essential Qualification: Graduate in Science, Life Sciences, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Public Health, Zoology, Nursing, Social Work, Hospital Management or any other relevant discipline from a recognized institution. Desirable Qualification: Knowledge of use of computer software, qualitative and quantitative data analysis, data collection, documentation, data entry, data cleaning, and data transcription. Preference will be given to candidates with hospital based experience. Age Limit: Upper age limit is 40 years as of 03-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs 21,000/-. The appointment under the project shall be on a "contract basis" initially for a period of one year, and it is further extendable up to 2 years based on individual performance and availability of funds.

content_sections.heading: ILBS Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be required to perform the following duties under the guidance of the Project team: To extract and update demographic, clinical, treatment, and follow up details in forms and online software of all cancer patients registered in ILBS. To do data analysis, noting, and drafting. Any other duties as assigned by the Project team.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ILBS Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Fill up the prescribed application form provided in the official notification PDF. Attach scanned copies of your degree, certificate, diploma, and testimonials. Forward the filled application form and scanned documents via email to [email protected] . Ensure the application reaches the specified email address by 03-11-2026, 5:00 pm. Shortlisted candidates will be required to bring all their photocopies of degrees, certificates, diplomas, and testimonials along with their printed application form when called for test/interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test, interview, or skill test at the Institute. No TA/DA will be provided to candidates attending the test or interview.
